summary: Run sanity tests from the collection directory with ansible-test sanity --docker using the default image; use --test to pick one, --list-tests to list them, and --allow-disabled to include disabled ones.
questions: How do I run sanity tests in a container?
How do I list available sanity tests?
How do I run just validate-modules?
How do I include disabled sanity tests?

answer_card.title: Run sanity tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
cd ~/ansible_collections/<NAMESPACE>/<COLLECTION_NAME>
ansible-test sanity --docker                         # all tests, default image
ansible-test sanity --docker --test validate-modules # one test
ansible-test sanity --list-tests
```
Add `--allow-disabled` to include disabled tests. Always use plain `--docker` without an image name.
